description: This file defines classes and functions related to cardinalities in Google Mock, including the CardinalityInterface and Cardinality classes, as well as factory functions for creating cardinality objects. It is used for specifying expected call counts in mock objects.

classes.name: CardinalityInterface
classes.description: Abstract interface for defining cardinality constraints on mock function calls.

classes.name: Cardinality
classes.description: Immutable class representing a cardinality, with methods to query call bounds and satisfaction.

methods.name: ConservativeLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the conservative lower bound of allowed calls.

methods.name: ConservativeUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the conservative upper bound of allowed calls.

methods.name: IsSatisfiedByCallCount
methods.description: Checks if a given call count satisfies the cardinality.

methods.name: IsSaturatedByCallCount
methods.description: Checks if a given call count saturates the cardinality.

methods.name: DescribeTo
methods.description: Describes the cardinality to an output stream.

methods.name: DescribeActualCallCountTo
methods.description: Describes an actual call count to an output stream.

methods.name: AtLeast
methods.description: Creates a cardinality allowing at least n calls.

methods.name: AtMost
methods.description: Creates a cardinality allowing at most n calls.

methods.name: AnyNumber
methods.description: Creates a cardinality allowing any number of calls.

methods.name: Between
methods.description: Creates a cardinality allowing between min and max calls.

methods.name: Exactly
methods.description: Creates a cardinality allowing exactly n calls.

methods.name: MakeCardinality
methods.description: Creates a Cardinality object from a CardinalityInterface pointer.
